# athenaSim: OB/GYN EHR workspace simulation (fictitious data)

**SIMULATION. Every patient, name, ID, result, note and claim here is fictitious and generated by code.**
A static test environment shaped like an ambulatory OB/GYN EHR workspace: dashboard (inbox counts, weekly
schedule, network panel), full schedule (day per-provider columns, week view), Clinical Inbox with folders,
patient chart (summary, problems, meds, allergies, vitals flowsheet, OB episode / prenatal flowsheet, labs,
imaging, documents/consults, encounters, claims), encounter notes with sign-off, claim worklist (denials with
reason codes and suggested fixes, missing slips, hold), daily practice report, weekly practice dashboard and a recall list.

It is an independent re-creation for automation testing. It contains no vendor code or assets and is not
affiliated with any EHR vendor.

Live: https://storkdoc.github.io/athena-sim/

## Time and data
* Sim date control in the red banner (range 2025-01-01 to 2027-12-31), and the time of day follows your real clock.
  `?simdate=YYYY-MM-DD` starts on a date.
* Deterministic: seed `congressional-sim-v1` produces about 5,200 fictitious patients with pregnancy episodes,
  annual exams and problem visits that are scheduled into provider templates. The same date always gives the same schedule,
  statuses, results, inbox, deliveries and claims. Past days show completed history, while future days show booked visits.
* Your actions (check-in, sign-off, close or route inbox items, bookings, claim fixes) are saved in localStorage.
  **Reset sim** clears them.

## Routes
`#/dashboard`, `#/schedule?d=YYYY-MM-DD&view=day|week`, `#/inbox/<Folder>`, `#/chart/<SIM id>/<tab>`,
`#/encounter/<appt id>`, `#/claims?tab=DENIED|MISSING%20SLIP|HOLD`, `#/report`, `#/dashboard-practice`,
`#/recall`, `#/openslots`, `#/cancellations`, `#/obpatients`, `#/patients?q=`.
`window.SIMDATA` exposes the generator.

## Tests
`node tests/smoke.js` (Playwright Chromium, with `BASE` pointing at a local server) checks every screen for console errors
and exercises the close, check-in, book and date-move flows.
